I’m auditing the repository’s rendered routes, metadata, crawl controls, structured data, and navigation directly from source. # GEO report: brightside-dental **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 79/100, Good Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 19.85 ÷ 25 × 100 = 79. High = (19.85 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 79. The site is statically rendered with crawlable navigation and a discoverable sitemap. The main issues are incorrect canonical URLs, invalid JSON-LD, and a noindexed page included in the sitemap. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Point canonicals at the declared site origin - **Why it matters:** Search engines may treat every page as belonging to the staging domain instead of the declared production domain. - **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:8` - **What the code says:** `` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 87/100 ### 2. Fix the invalid Dentist JSON-LD - **Why it matters:** The trailing comma makes the structured data invalid and prevents machines from reliably parsing the business information. - **Where:** `src/contact.njk:10` - **What the code says:** `{ "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "Dentist", "name": "Brightside Dental", "telephone": "0113 496 0000", }` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 87/100 ### 3. Remove the noindexed services page from the sitemap, or make it indexable - **Why it matters:** The sitemap explicitly asks crawlers to visit a page that declares `noindex`. - **Where:** `src/services.njk:5` - **What the code says:** `noindex: true` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 82/100 ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | Reachable, valid robots.txt | Clear | `src/robots.txt:1-3` | | GEO-009 | Search crawler access matches policy | Clear | `geo.config.json:1`; `src/robots.txt:1-2` | | GEO-014 | Sitemap and linked routes are indexable | Problem | Services is noindexed; 3 of 4 sitemap routes are indexable | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on declared origin | Problem | `src/_includes/base.njk:8`; staging origin conflicts with `geo.config.json:1` | | GEO-003 | Primary content in server HTML | Clear | Eleventy static templates in `src/*.njk` | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD parses correctly | Problem | `src/contact.njk:9-10`; trailing comma invalidates JSON | | GEO-011 | Discoverable, valid sitemap | Clear | `src/robots.txt:3`; `src/sitemap.xml:1-6` | | GEO-012 | Title, description and HTML language | Problem | `src/_includes/base.njk:2,6-7`; team lacks a description | | GEO-016 | Key routes reachable through server-rendered links | Clear | `src/_includes/base.njk:12` | | GEO-017 | Snippet restrictions match AI-search policy | Clear | `src/contact.njk:8` is scoped `data-nosnippet`, not page-wide | | GEO-002 | Selected accessibility checks | Clear | Sampled layout and homepage; named links, image alt, and titles present | | GEO-101 | Mobile app association files | Not applicable | No mobile app declaration found | | GEO-010 | `llms.txt` presence (informational) | Not applicable | No `llms.txt` found | | GEO-102 | App-specific structured data (informational) | Not applicable | No app profile declared | ## Other problems found None found beyond the scored issues. ## Worth considering - **Explain the “thousands of local patients” claim:** `src/index.njk:7`: `Trusted by thousands of local patients.` Add supporting evidence or a more specific, verifiable explanation. - **Publish the actual prices promised:** `src/services.njk:9`: `Our prices are simple and clear.` Include the prices or link to a page that lists them. - **Add dentist names and credentials:** `src/team.njk:5-6`: `Meet the team` and `Our experienced dentists have decades of experience between them.` Add individual profiles, qualifications and areas of expertise. - **Describe emergency care:** `src/index.njk:7`: `Emergency appointments available.` Add hours, eligibility and booking instructions. - **Add service detail links:** `src/services.njk:8`: `
  • Check-ups
  • Hygiene
  • Implants
  • Whitening
` Give important treatments dedicated pages if visitors need detailed information. - **Add social metadata:** `src/_includes/base.njk:3-9` contains standard metadata but no Open Graph or Twitter tags. Add them to improve shared-page previews. - **Add business details to structured data:** `src/contact.njk:7`: `Call 0113 496 0000 or visit 12 Park Row, Leeds.` Label the visible address and contact information in valid structured data. ## Can't tell from code - **GEO-013 live status:** Source shows a valid passthrough file, but only a live check can confirm the deployed `/robots.txt` response. - **GEO-014 and GEO-011:** Source cannot confirm redirects, status codes, or the final contents of deployed routes. - **GEO-015:** Source cannot confirm that canonical targets return 200 and are indexable. - **GEO-003 and GEO-016:** The code is statically rendered, but live HTML would confirm the deployed output. - **GEO-002:** Full rendered-page accessibility checks require a live page. - **Bot protection:** Code cannot show whether a CDN or firewall allows real crawlers. Confirm with `geopilot logs `. ## Assumptions - You want Brightside Dental discoverable by search engines and AI search tools, based on `policy.aiSearchCrawlers: "allow"`. - The domain in `geo.config.json` is the intended production origin. - The five Nunjucks templates are the representative routes for this small site. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You’ll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-015`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any search or AI product.
